## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated (fail without the change, pass with it)
- [ ] `pnpm build`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass locally
- [ ] A changeset was added (`pnpm changeset`) for user-facing changes
- [ ] Comments and error messages are in English
- [ ] Respects the dependency-layer rule (no same-layer or upward imports)
- [ ] Stable error `code`s were not renamed (or the change is flagged as breaking)
